source: Game Concept/narrative/FINAL_SCRIPT.md, SC08 and its encounter notes. Lines marked "system": true are gameplay feedback, hints or placeholder prompts that are not in the script; review them before release.

keeper.text: Eren is the fortress keeper. He lies behind a copper grille, attached by the wrist to a failing ritual circuit. A hyena watches from a broken stair. It withdraws when noticed.

keeper.speaker: EREN
keeper.text: Of course it is. Of course she gave you one.

keeper.caption: [memory]
keeper.text: A child-height view of the grille from inside. Then the same grille from outside. Same crack, different angles.

keeper.speaker: EREN
keeper.text: Your mother took the registers. I kept the transfer slips. Archive courtyard. Under the blue drain tile.

keeper.speaker: TAVO
keeper.text: Why do you know my mother?

keeper.speaker: EREN
keeper.text: I want to say I only counted them.

keeper.speaker: EREN
keeper.text: I put the numbers where their names had been.
He tries to disconnect himself. A copper channel lights.

keeper.speaker: EREN
keeper.text: Don't let them make you the answer again.

flood.text: The room floods with dark water. Nali hauls at Eren's chain, but the current is too strong.
Climb the marked stair before the water reaches you.

collapse.text: A section of the stair collapses beneath him.
